gloss: just as you say; exactly right

definitions.gloss: just as you say; exactly as you say; you're absolutely right
definitions.explanation: A polite expression used to agree wholeheartedly with what someone has said. The respectful form of その{通|とお}り.

examples.japanese: {仰|おっしゃ}る{通|とお}りです。
{先生|せんせい}の{仰|おっしゃ}る{通|とお}り、もっと{練習|れんしゅう}が{必要|ひつよう}です。
examples.english: Just as the teacher says, more practice is needed.

examples.japanese: {仰|おっしゃ}る{通|とお}り、{現状|げんじょう}のままでは{問題|もんだい}が{解決|かいけつ}しません。
examples.english: As you rightly point out, the problem won't be solved if things stay as they are.

notes:
USAGE:
A highly polite expression of agreement, appropriate in business meetings, formal conversations, and when speaking to superiors. {仰|おっしゃ}る is the honorific form of {言|い}う.

FORMALITY SCALE:
- その{通|とお}り (neutral)
- {言|い}う{通|とお}り (casual)
- おっしゃる{通|とお}り (formal/honorific)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- その{通|とお}り: that's right — neutral level of agreement
- まさに: exactly — emphasizes precision of the point
